cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Not Dismissed
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by treating departure as a privilege only you can grant.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before you put your coat on, I'd like to formally conclude our coffee.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only stopped for ten minutes. My bus is due.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then I'll consider an early departure. Sit down while I decide.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The café's closing. They've asked us both to leave.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. We'll wait outside together. Their permission to leave doesn't replace mine.

mechanism: A treats a casual coffee as a professionally chaired session whose conclusion and departure only A may authorise, even when the venue closes.
confusable: D26 delays through little requests; this scene must explicitly make permission to leave depend on A formal judgement rather than another task.
comparison: Shop alternative exaggerates managerial authority; coffee alternative invents release authority over an equal social companion.
seedUse: Ten-minute visit, bus and closing cafe derive from D50-b; S03 adds minutes-versus-conclusion and venue-versus-session distinctions.
